description: Keep one short note for the candidate on TrueInterview, so the agents they connect know it next time: a goal, the companies they target, a constraint (a start date, a place they cannot move from) or a preference. Save only what the candidate asked you to keep, or agreed to when you offered, in their words, and tell them what you saved. Never the conversation itself, a guess, a self-identification answer (gender, ethnicity, veteran status, disability) or anything about someone else. A bank card or government ID number, a password or a token is refused and nothing is saved, and so is a note with fewer than three letters or digits. Saving the same note again changes nothing; with no topic, the same words under any topic count as the same note, and a new one is filed under "other". They can ask you to show or delete any note.

text.description: The note in the candidate's words, at most 1,000 characters.

name: save_context_note
title: Keep a note for me
